where: The top of the Old Light on Pearlmoor Point — the joke-tower's punchline lantern room and its celebratory send-off
mood: Festival of the floating lights — the quay waltz in its happiest dress, quick, ornamented and playful.
core_styles: lively accordion-like pulse-wave lead with quick grace-note runs
busy bell-buoy chimes and bright sparkle on phrase ends
light tambourine on beats two and three, brush on the downbeat
seaside festival dance, celebratory, playful and a little cheeky

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a bright festive fanfare: a quick tambourine pickup and a flourish of grace-note runs on the lead, landing on a held chord that springs straight into the waltz}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the waltz melody bright and quick, ornamented with grace notes, swinging on every downbeat, hummable and joyful}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the same waltz again with a pizzicato and bell counter-line hopping on the offbeats, a little cheeky, fuller}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a short comic tiptoe in D minor, staccato and sly like a joke being set up, then a rising run tumbles back into the theme}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the festive waltz returns in full swing; the last bar springs straight back into the theme, no ending}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
